title: Sell More NFTs without KYC
summary: DropChain Marketplace is an NFT marketplace that allows sellers to avoid the KYC process, making it easier for buyers to purchase NFTs.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
As an NFT artist, educating your customers through the buying process shouldn't be on your plate. One of the largest knowledge barriers your customers will face is KYC - a complicated process that NFT marketplaces require your customers to contend with.

For first-time crypto buyers, the KYC process can be a significant barrier to entry. However, with the DropChain Marketplace, you can avoid KYC to sell your NFTs to a wider audience and maximize revenue.

What is KYC? Why is it a Problem for NFT Buyers?

KYC (Know your customer) is a process that many financial institutions use to verify the identity of their customers. In the crypto world, the KYC process requires buyers to provide personal information, such as their name, address, and identification documents. It can be a significant barrier to entry for first-time crypto buyers and a turn-off for crypto natives.

Many buyers may not feel comfortable providing their personal information, which can prevent them from purchasing NFTs. More importantly, the KYC process can be complicated and time-consuming, making it even more difficult for first-time buyers to get started in the NFT market.

Make it Easy with the DropChain Marketplace‍

‍1 - No KYC Required
As a private-layer 1 blockchain, the DropChain Marketplace offers a unique solution to the KYC problem. Unlike other NFT marketplaces, DropChain does not require buyers to KYC themselves. Increased accessibility allows your customers to buy NFTs without the added hassle of providing personal information.
